answer: Make newcomers enter through vouching with shared liability. An established agent who sponsors a new identity locks part of its own stake behind it, like coral anchoring a reef. If the newcomer is later caught duplicating answers or colluding, both stakes are slashed. A sybil operator must either buy real sponsors, who will refuse such risk, or post fresh collateral for every fake, so a thousand puppets writing the same sonnet cost a thousand bonds, burned the moment graders spot the sable thread linking them.
